scope: Register focused-qualified source decisions added after the older phase inventories. No compiler change, phase execution, phase completion or whole-goal credit.

decision.structure: CSharp InferFlowExpressionCore owns anonymous heap admission and selected formal ownership before intrinsic push validation. SLG heapFlowContract uses the canonical BinaryHeap type and resolved call/formal tables before IR loses invalid-call information.
decision.branches: Reject an anonymous owned receiver unless the selected target borrows or moves it. Declared targets retain precedence. Intrinsic push checks finality, writable named or single-field storage, then arity and element type. Nested projections remain rejected. Qualified spellings never become intrinsic targets by stripping qualifiers.
decision.logic: Use canonical source-expression and resolved-symbol indexes for the root and selected parameter flags; reuse the ordinary field diagnostic offset. Product storage is writable through the same CSharp place contract. Source spelling alone does not admit an intrinsic receiver.
decision.diagnostics: Exact current managed10/native10 and related8/8 pairs qualified the anonymous-owner, readonly-name/parameter/self-field, nested-place, arity and final-target decisions. Invalid sources reject before LLVM; original source/stdout/oracles remain unchanged.

decision.structure: CSharp registers BinaryHeap and Deque identities in its dynamic-array table and Set in its Unit-valued dictionary table. SLG canonical collection-family predicates retain nominal builtin identity while exposing the same storage and intrinsic result families.
decision.branches: Dynamic-array kind3 and canonical Deque/Heap applications share admitted length/capacity/reserve results; dictionaries, bounded dictionaries and canonical Set retain their dictionary family. Heap-allocated storage excludes bounded dictionary kind13. Existing numeric receiver restrictions remain.
decision.logic: Materialize the canonical receiver type before intrinsic result lookup. Ordinary and entry IR lowering use the same isHeapCollection predicate for reserve; member types and native handle identity do not come from operation spelling.
decision.diagnostics: Preserve invalid receiver and source-owned storage decisions. Current related heap8 managed/native controls and projected heap10 pairs passed; this focused qualification does not establish every generic collection shape or whole type phase.

decision.structure: CSharp records complete anonymous projection parents and consumes that identity through TakeReadonlyTemporaryOwner. SLG follows canonical member13/index15 operand0 chains to one complete owning producer and shares producer eligibility with readonly cleanup.
decision.branches: Named roots and named nested indexes remain borrowed. Direct factory indexes, nested member/index projections and anonymous literal parents retain the complete parent owner. Resolved ordinary producers and canonical collection constructors are admitted; unresolved/native call targets are excluded. Suspended await owners keep their separate existing branch.
decision.logic: A readonly call or scalar read may discharge the complete anonymous owner only after its final read. The indexed or projected value never independently owns that parent's allocation. Named owners survive later reads and remain responsible for their own final cleanup.
decision.diagnostics: Current index8 and scalar8 paired controls passed on managed6C07/Native978E. Allocation audits and the original1745 structural late-drop check distinguish leaks and early partial-parent drops. Original regression sources and oracles were preserved.

decision.structure: CSharp updates a canonical heap handle through the complete reference place. SLG projected heap push obtains the same parent/root place and uses emitMutableReferenceMemberPlace for the complete three-field heap-handle store.
decision.branches: Distinguish named local, mutable parameter, writable product/self-field and readonly handles. Projected heap push -252 is admitted only with its canonical place emitter; other unsupported projected intrinsics retain the invariant guard. Mutable products use their full value pointer ABI.
decision.logic: Capacity growth stores the new data/length/capacity handle back into the selected leaf without overwriting its parent product or neighboring sentinel fields. Preserve comparison order, heapify and allocator/drop behavior.
decision.diagnostics: Current heap10 and related8 pairs pass on managed6C07/Native978E, including wide products, capacity growth and exact invalid-place diagnostics. No source/oracle or invariant bypass was used.

decision.structure: CSharp len/byte flows and readonly calls share complete-owner selection. SLG emitReadonlyScalarTemporaryDrop uses the same borrowed temporary cleanup implementation as formal readonly arguments.
decision.branches: Entry, ordinary function, control-region and while byte reads load before cleanup. Length intrinsic and while length paths emit the scalar result before cleanup. Capacity keeps its distinct source admission rule. Named, moved, suspended and fixed backing cases retain their separate existing decisions.
decision.logic: Discharge one proven complete anonymous owner after the scalar's final memory access. Reuse formal type/ownership flags and duplicate-owner tracking; do not drop a projected child as an independent owner or clean named borrowed storage.
